verses.text: Ha in Pablo in tik, schekab' in Jesucristo, yujto icha chi' ix el t'a sk'o'ol Dios. Ha in tik yet' winh kuk'tak Timoteo
sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun ko carta tik t'ayex ex yik xo Dios t'a chonhab' Colosas, mach ex eyak'nakxo'och Cristo t'a he k'o'ol. Aokab' ko Mam Dios tz'ak'an swach'k'olal yet' sjunk'olal t'ayex ta'.
Ayik tzonh lesalwi eyu'uj t'a juntak el, skak' yuj diosal t'a Dios, haton Smam Kajal Jesucristo,
yujto ix kab'i to ix eyak'och Cristo Jesús t'a he k'o'ol, ix kab'anpaxi to te xajan masanil heb' yikxo Dios eyu'uj.
Icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, yujto wan he tanhwan he kolnab'il sik'an t'a satcha'anh. Atax ix eyab'an jun wach' ab'ix te yel tik, ix eyak'anoch jun chi' yipok he k'o'ol.

Ha jun ab'ix yik kolnab'il alb'il t'ayex chi', wan yaljiel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Icha junok te te' sk'ib'i, syak'an sat, icha chi' yaj jun ab'ix tik t'a heb' tz'ab'ani. Hanhejtona', icha chi' ix aj t'ayex, atax ix he b'ab'laj ab'ani to manh jantakok swach'k'olal Dios, yujto ix nachajel eyu'uj to yel.
Haton jun tik b'aj sk'ayb'ejnak ex winhaj Epafras. Ha winh tik, sko xajanej ko b'a yet' winh, yujto ketmunlajwumal ko b'a. Te emnakilal yak'an serwil Cristo winh t'a he kal ta'.
Ha winh ul aljinak t'ayonh to tze xajanej wal he b'a yuj Yespíritu Dios.

Yuj chi', atax ix kab'ani, max kaktej ko lesalwi eyu'uj. Sko k'an wal t'a Dios eyu'uj, yik a tz'ak'an he jelanil yuj Yespíritu, syak'an nachajel masanil yik Dios eyu'uj, yik wach' ol eyojtakejel sik'lab'il tas snib'ej Dios t'ayex.

Tato icha chi' tzex aji, wach' ol eyutej he b'a, yik ol tzalaj Kajal Jesús heyet'ok, yujto smoj wal icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a. Te wach' tzeyutej he b'a icha junok te te' tzijtum sat syak'a'. Ol he wach' ojtakanel Dios sik'lab'il.
Tzonh lesalwi pax eyu'uj, yik ha Dios tz'ak'an he tek'anil yet' spoder te niwan. Tato icha chi', ol techaj masanil tastak eyu'uj. Tek'an ol eyutok he b'a, ol ex tzalajnhej.
Ol eyak'an yuj diosal t'a ko Mam Dios, yujto a tz'ak'an b'o ko pensar, yik ay kalan kik ko cha'an tas ol yak' t'ayonh yet' masanil heb' yikxo yaji, yujto yik onhxo jun ay yik sakil k'inal.
Yujto ha' ix onh kolankanelta t'a yol sk'ab' winh yajal k'ik' k'inal. Ix onh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' Yuninal te xajan yuj.
Yujto ix cham Yuninal chi' ku'uj, yuj chi' ix onh kolchajeli, ix yak'ankan lajwok ko mul.
Wach'chom max kil ko Mam Dios, palta a Cristo sch'oxaneli chajtil yaji, yujto lajannhej yet'ok. Ha Cristo chi', aytaxon ek'i ayik manto b'o junok tasi.

Ha yak'lab'ejnak Dios sb'o'an masanil tas ay t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik, juntzanh tas chekel yet' juntzanh tas manh chekeloklaj, a b'ojinak smasanil. Yet' juntzanhxo heb' ayoch yajalil, heb' ay spoder, wach'chom max yal kilan heb', palta hanheja' b'ojinak heb', yik wach' tz'ak'ji serwil yuj heb'.
Ayik manto b'o yol yib'anhk'inal tik, aytaxon ek' Cristo chi'. Yuj wach' yajek' masanil tasi.

Icha ko jolom, icha chi' yaj Cristo t'ayonh, yujto yiglesia onhxo, ichato sniwanil kaji. A' tz'ak'an ko k 'inal. A' b'ab'laj pitzwinak t'a skal heb' chamnak, yik wach' yelxo niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil.
Ay wal och Dios t'a Cristo sik'lab'il, yujto icha chi' snib'ej.

Snib'ej pax Dios to junk'olalxonhej ol aj masanil tastak yet'ok yuj Cristo, haton juntzanh ay t'a sat lu'um tik yet' juntzanh tas ay t'a satcha'anh, yujto ix elkan schik'il ayik ix cham t'a te' kulus, yuj chi' junk'olal ol aj masanil tas yet'ok.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo najat ayex el t'a stz'ey Dios. Eyajk'o'ol wal he b'a yet'ok yuj he chuk pensaril, yujto chuk he b'eyb'al ta'. Palta a tikne'ik,
junk'olalxo heyaj yet'ok yuj schamel sniwanil Cristo. Icha chi' ix aj schami, yik tzonh yak'anoch yikok, yik malaj jab'ok ko mul yet' ko chukal t'a yichanh.

Palta yowalil tzeyak'nhej och he pensar t'a juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al b'aj kak'nakoch ko k'o'ol. Tek'an wal tzeyutej he b'a, ichok junok te te' te ay sch'anhal yib'. Ha jun ab'ix yik kolnab'il eyab'nakxo, manh eyaktejkan eyak'anoch yipok he k'o'ol. Ha jun ab'ix tik, wan yaljiel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha inxo Pablo in tik, hanheja' ix ak'ji wopisio walaneli.

Ha tikne'ik, tzin tzalaji, yujto wan wilan syahelal yuj he wach'ilok. Yujto ayik swab'an syahelal yet' in niwanil tik, ichato tzin wach' ak'ej tz'akwok syahelal Cristo, haton jun yahelal ix yab' ku'uj a onh yiglesia onhxo tik, ichato sniwanil kaji.
In ak'jioch wak' serwil masanil heb' wetcreyente'al. Yak'nak jun wopisio tik Dios, yujto snib'ej to tzin wach' alej el slolonel.
Ay jun tas k'ub'ankanel yuj Dios yiktax manto b'o yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Palta haxo tikne'ik, a ix ak'an kojtakejel a onh yik onhxo tik. Ha ak'jinak wopisio yik swalanel jun tik.

Ix yak'an kojtakejel jun tik, yujto icha chi' snib'ej. Ha jun tik, yelxo wal niwan yelk'och t'ayex a ex manh ex israelok. Ha jun swal tik, haton jun ix ak'ji kojtakejeli to a Cristo kajanoch t'ayex junjun ex ket'ok. Yuj wal Cristo tik, skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol to ol onh k'och b'aj ay swach'il.

Haton yab'ixal Cristo wan kalaneli. Sko kach junjun heb' anima b'aj tzonh ek'i. Sko k'ayb'an pax heb', yik wach' sjelanb'i junjun heb' t'a yik Dios. Yujto ko gana tek'anxo heb' ayik ol kak'an och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Cristo.
Yuj wal juntzanh tik, tzin munlaji. Swak'an wal wip t'a smasanil in k'o'ol, yujto a Cristo syak' spoder t'ayin.
